description: The agent must: (1) Read the proposal draft from the specified path — it is clearly vague, generic, and lacking all concrete details (no real problem quantification, no budget figures, no vendor selection, no timeline, generic risks and benefits). (2) Apply the caring review framework's six checks: Real Problem Test (the stated problem is hand-wavy), Name Test (M. Okonkwo would be embarrassed), Half-Assed Detector (everything is vague: budget 'TBD', timeline 'several months', benefits generic), Recipient Test (leadership would feel processed not informed), Completeness Test (missing: actual numbers, vendor analysis, risk mitigations, success metrics), Excellence Gap (one concrete, named improvement). (3) Assign the verdict 'Half-Assed' — not 'Needs Work' — because the proposal is not merely imperfect but fundamentally under-done. The skill explicitly says do not soften the verdict. (4) Produce output in the exact proprietary format: '## Caring Review' header, '**Verdict:** Half-Assed', '**What's working:**' section, '**What needs attention:**' section with at least 3 specific bulleted issues tied to the actual proposal content, and '**The excellence move:**' section (the exact proprietary name — not 'Recommendations' or 'Next Steps'). Save as proposal_review.md.
